node.title: Moving polynomial normals share one degree-bounded label-owned tuple resource
node.statement: For2<=e<s<=K and a fixed degree<K carrier V with independent ell0..ell(e-1), distinct original labels with size m=K+d scalar supports and chosen defects1<=tau<=T<=d are assumed to have nonzero V evaluation on each joint core and pair lines satisfying the formal polynomial identity sum z^i ell_i(a-a0+z(b-b0))=0. At most K-s+e original labels are exceptional; the remaining raw mass is<=floor[e(n)_s/(s(m-T)prod_(j=1)^(s-2)(d-T+j))]. One fixed incidence line section has at most e label owners. No per-label cancellation, arbitrary-hypersurface claim, HIGH funding or noncontained-line census is imported. Stronger-basis interface: any separately proved uniform lower bound B_* for the retained actual (s-1)-kernel core bases gives remaining raw mass<=floor[e(n)_s/(s B_*)], with the SAME label-exception count and common tuple budget.
